task.object: Review the analytic and finite claims added by Claude in commit 062baf8 on h(P_5).
deliverables: Corrected checkpoint, mathematical review, small counterexample checker and exact replay evidence.

assumptions: Finite simple planar graphs of girth at least five.
Move bound: connected, with a cycle or at least four vertices.
Unavoidable sets: minimum degree at least three; bad pairs are the least inductive closure.
Finite scans use exactly the encoded induced graph and distinct private ports.
mathematical_context.domain: Proper four-colourings and their single-vertex recolouring graphs; exact finite state sets.

python.existence_evidence: Repository sources inspected; standard library only.
python.availability_evidence: Live python3 version check and completed original full Python replay; CPython 3.14.6.

decision.selection_reason: Replay the original exact Python/C implementations, and use a separate small Python implementation to check counterexamples and planar embeddings.
decision.fallback_reason: not-required; no CAS substitution is needed for the supplied exact enumeration.

execution.interface: Local Python standard library and compiled C subprocesses; eight residues per large configuration, at most six classifier processes.
execution.command_or_input: python3 -B output/research/girth5-pinch-pentagon-trees-20261015/pinch_tree_scan.py; python3 -B output/research/girth5-pinch-pentagon-trees-20261015/review_checks.py; cc -O3 -Wall -Wextra -Wconversion -o /tmp/p5_fibre_classifier output/research/girth5-pinch-pentagon-trees-20261015/fibre_classifier.c; for each of chain3_distance2, chain3_adjacent, PI_flower, C3, generate input with fibre_configs.py and run /tmp/p5_fibre_classifier 8 r for r=0..7. Exact commands, inputs and raw results are in review-c-replay.json.

result.summary: All nine finite table rows reproduced. The original Python report is byte-identical; all four large C rows match their claimed canonical counts and minima. Small exact checks establish the C1 exception, varying/disconnected leaf layers, and two realizable missing face-union geometries. Analytic review validates the six/eight move bound and unavoidable sets, but no Hamiltonicity conclusion follows.

methods: Analytic review of hypotheses, angle accounting, discharging and restoration dependencies.
Read the primary Bartier source, Sections 3.2-3.3.
Full original Python replay, with byte-identical original report.
Full C replay of all boundary orbits for the last four table rows, partitioned by canonical ordinal modulo eight.
Separately implemented C1/leaf-path examples and complete sphere-map, girth, degree and selected-face-preservation checks.
Existing article certificate readers rerun with unchanged reports.
verification.residual_or_error: All mathematical state and graph checks use exact integers/sets. C averages are display-only and rounded to one decimal place.
limitations: Full C reruns reuse the original classifier; this is not an independent implementation of the large scans.
Finite bare-model checks do not prove any unbounded pentagon-tree or flower theorem.
Extra internal edges, identifications and simultaneous shared-port moves are not covered by the original table.
No Hamiltonian restoration theorem, h(P_5)=4, or hc(P_5)=4 is proved.
Unretained plantri, SAT and dodecahedron scratch runs were not replayed.
